function addLiquidity( uint256 amountADesired, uint256 amountBDesired, uint256 amountAMin, uint256 amountBMin, uint256 deadline ) external nonReentrant ensure(deadline) returns (uint256 amountA, uint256 amountB, uint256 mintedShares) { require(amountADesired > 0 && amountBDesired > 0, "zero amounts"); if (totalShares == 0) { (amountA, amountB) = (amountADesired, amountBDesired); } else { uint256 amountBOptimal = (amountADesired * reserveB) / reserveA; if (amountBOptimal <= amountBDesired) { (amountA, amountB) = (amountADesired, amountBOptimal); } else { uint256 amountAOptimal = (amountBDesired * reserveA) / reserveB; (amountA, amountB) = (amountAOptimal, amountBDesired); } } require(amountA >= amountAMin && amountB >= amountBMin, "slippage exceeded"); if (totalShares == 0) { mintedShares = _sqrt(amountA * amountB); require(mintedShares > MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY, "insufficient initial liquidity"); mintedShares -= MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY; totalShares = MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY; shares[address(0)] = MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY; emit Transfer(address(0), address(0), MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY); } else { uint256 s0 = (amountA * totalShares) / reserveA; uint256 s1 = (amountB * totalShares) / reserveB; mintedShares = s0 < s1 ? s0 : s1; } require(mintedShares > 0, "insufficient liquidity minted"); reserveA += amountA; reserveB += amountB; totalShares += mintedShares; shares[msg.sender] += mintedShares; emit Transfer(address(0), msg.sender, mintedShares); emit LiquidityAdded(msg.sender, amountA, amountB, mintedShares); _pull(tokenA, amountA); _pull(tokenB, amountB); }
